This 2022 Buick Envision Preferred SPORT TOURING puts refined performance and capability within your reach, offering a well-equipped crossover designed for drivers who value both style and substance.

Key features that define this vehicle include:

- Power panoramic tilt-sliding moonroof
- 20" wheels with Dark finish and Sport Touring badging
- 2.0L turbocharged engine with 9-speed automatic and AWD
- Buick Infotainment System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- 7-speaker enhanced audio system with amplifier and SiriusXM
- Heated steering wheel and heated driver/front passenger seats
- Hands-free power liftgate
- Dual-zone automatic air conditioning
- Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert
- Rear Cross Traffic Alert
- Remote vehicle starter system
- Sport pedals and unique Sport Touring design elements
- 4-wheel disc brakes with electronic stability control

The exterior presents a striking Black finish complemented by Dark Gloss accents throughout—from the grille surround to the window trim and mirror caps. The Sport Touring package distinguishes this model with body-color door handles, black roof rails, and carpeted floor mats bearing the Sport Touring logo. Inside, the cabin combines practicality with comfort through its dual-zone climate control, premium audio system, and thoughtfully designed seating with leatherette trim.

Under the hood, the 2.0L turbocharged engine paired with the 9-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers dependable performance. With EPA ratings of 22 city and 29 highway, this powertrain balances efficiency with capability for varied driving conditions. The four-wheel independent suspension and responsive steering contribute to a composed driving experience on both urban streets and open roads.

Safety has been prioritized with a comprehensive suite of features including dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control. The Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert and Rear Cross Traffic Alert provide additional awareness, while brake assist and ABS brakes enhance stopping confidence.

Comfort and convenience are woven throughout the interior with power-adjustable driver seating, remote keyless entry, an auto-dimming rearview mirror, and telescoping steering wheel. The hands-free power liftgate and rear cargo compartment cover make daily utility seamless, while the remote vehicle starter system adds practical convenience.

This 2022 Buick Envision Preferred SPORT TOURING represents a solid choice for those seeking a capable, well-appointed crossover. We invite you to experience it firsthand and discover how it fits your driving lifestyle.

A dual moonroof opens the cabin to light for front and rear passengers. The Cargo Package adds practical versatility, and thoughtful storage areas help keep everyday essentials organized. Rain-sensing windshield wipers, heated exterior mirrors, and automatic headlights with auto high beams make changing weather and nighttime driving easier to manage.

Confidence is supported by electronic stability control, traction control, anti-lock brakes, brake assist, multiple airbags, and Mazda Connect emergency communication capability. The rearview camera provides a helpful perspective when backing into tight spaces, while the available convenience of cruise control makes longer highway journeys more relaxing.

Check out this 2025 Toyota RAV4 XLE finished in Silver Sky Metallic with a Ash interior. This vehicle is equipped with the following features and options: Convenience
  • Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
  • Smart device engine start control - Phone ahead. Remotely start your vehicle's engine from your smart device, ensuring your ride is ready to go when you get in. Now you can stay comfortable inside while your vehicle gets comfortable outside, thanks to Smart device engine start control.
In-car Entertainment
  • Touchscreen - flat out convenient. Say goodbye to the twists and turns of your daily drive...we're talking about buttons and knobs of course! Touchscreen allows you to control certain features with your fingertips, making it easy to use while also providing information at a glance. With touchscreen, your fingerprints will be all over your drive.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

Discover the perfect combination of sporty styling, comfort, technology, and everyday practicality with this Certified 2025 Honda HR-V Sport finished in eye-catching Milano Red. This stylish SUV is an excellent choice for drivers looking for a modern vehicle that offers a comfortable ride, versatile interior space, and convenient features for everyday life. Whether you are commuting to work, running errands, or planning a weekend getaway, the Honda HR-V Sport is ready to fit your lifestyle.

The beautiful Milano Red exterior gives this HR-V a bold and energetic appearance that stands out wherever you go. Its sporty front grille, sleek LED headlights, sculpted body lines, and attractive alloy wheels create a modern and athletic look. The Sport trim adds distinctive styling that makes this SUV especially appealing to drivers who appreciate a little extra personality in their vehicle. Its compact size also makes it convenient to maneuver through city streets and tight parking spaces.

Inside, the 2025 Honda HR-V Sport offers a comfortable and thoughtfully designed cabin with plenty of room for passengers. The interior features a modern layout, supportive seating, and convenient controls that help make every drive enjoyable. Heated front seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, and a spacious seating area add comfort to your daily routine. The versatile cargo area provides room for groceries, luggage, shopping bags, and other essentials, while the folding rear seats offer additional flexibility when you need to carry larger items.

Under the hood, the HR-V Sport features a 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission, delivering smooth and practical performance for everyday driving. Its responsive handling and comfortable ride make it an excellent choice for commuting, city travel, and highway cruising. The HR-V is designed to provide a balanced driving experience that combines convenience and efficiency with the versatility of an SUV.

Technology and connectivity are also important highlights of this Honda. Features include a touchscreen infotainment system, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, and convenient controls that help you stay connected while driving. Honda Sensing driver-assistance technologies are designed to support driver awareness and confidence, with features such as Collision Mitigation Braking, Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keeping Assist, and Road Departure Mitigation.

As a Certified 2025 Honda HR-V Sport, this vehicle may offer additional peace of mind through Honda's Certified Pre-Owned program. Certification benefits depend on the applicable program and the vehicle's eligibility, so ask us about the inspection, warranty coverage, roadside assistance, and other benefits included with this specific vehicle.

With its eye-catching exterior color, modern design, comfortable interior, and convenient features, this Honda HR-V Sport is an excellent choice for anyone looking for a vehicle that combines practicality, reliability, and everyday comfort. Whether you are commuting to work, running errands around town, or heading out for a weekend getaway, this SUV is designed to fit your lifestyle.

The 2025 Honda HR-V Sport stands out with its bold styling, sleek body lines, sporty front grille, and attractive exterior details. Finished in beautiful Milano Red, this SUV brings a vibrant and energetic look to the road. Its modern appearance and athletic design make it a great option for drivers who want a vehicle that looks as good as it drives. The compact size also makes it easy to maneuver through city streets, navigate busy parking lots, and handle everyday driving with confidence.

Step inside, and you will find a comfortable and thoughtfully designed interior that offers plenty of room for both the driver and passengers. The cabin features a clean layout, supportive seating, convenient storage areas, and easy-to-use controls that help make every trip enjoyable. With generous passenger space and a versatile cargo area, the HR-V Sport is ready to accommodate your daily needs. Whether you are carrying groceries, shopping bags, luggage, or sports equipment, this SUV offers the flexibility you need for your busy lifestyle.

The Sport trim adds an athletic touch to the HR-V with stylish design accents and convenient features. Enjoy the comfort of heated front seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, and a user-friendly infotainment system designed to keep you connected while on the road. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility make it easy to access your favorite music, navigation, calls, and messages through your compatible smartphone. The thoughtfully designed interior and modern technology help create a driving experience that is both comfortable and convenient.

Under the hood, the 2025 Honda HR-V Sport is powered by a 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission (CVT), providing smooth and practical performance for everyday driving. Its responsive handling and comfortable ride make it a great companion for commuting, running errands, and traveling on the highway. The HR-V is also designed with everyday efficiency in mind, making it a sensible choice for drivers who want a versatile SUV without sacrificing practicality.

Safety is another important part of the Honda HR-V experience. Honda Sensing driver-assistance technologies include features designed to help support awareness and confidence behind the wheel, such as collision mitigation braking, road departure mitigation, adaptive cruise control, and lane keeping assistance. These technologies work alongside the vehicle's other safety systems to help make everyday driving more reassuring. Whether you are navigating traffic or traveling on the highway, the HR-V Sport is designed to help you feel more confident on the road.

One of the biggest advantages of the Honda HR-V is its versatility. The spacious cabin provides comfortable seating for passengers, while the flexible cargo area makes it easy to carry everyday essentials and larger items when needed. Its practical design makes it a great choice for individuals, couples, small families, and anyone looking for an SUV that can adapt to different situations. From weekday commutes to weekend adventures, this Honda HR-V is ready to keep up with your plans.

2011 Ford Edge Limited AWD: Premium Comfort, Dynamic V6 Performance, and All-Weather Confidence
Smooth Ti-VCT V6 Power and Capable Intelligent AWD
The 2011 Ford Edge Limited AWD blends executive sophistication with robust, dependable performance. Under the hood lies Ford’s upgraded 3.5-liter Duratec V6 engine featuring Twin Independent Variable Camshaft Timing (Ti-VCT), delivering a spirited 285 horsepower and 253 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a smooth-shifting 6-speed SelectShift® automatic transmission, it provides brisk acceleration and quiet highway cruising. Equipped with Ford's Intelligent All-Wheel Drive system, the Edge continuously monitors traction to seamlessly transfer power between front and rear wheels, delivering supreme stability in heavy rain, deep snow, and unpaved conditions.

Executive-Class Leather Cabin with Advanced Technology
Step inside the top-tier Limited model to experience a spacious, upscale sanctuary designed for five passengers. The interior is clad in supple leather-trimmed seating, featuring 10-way power-adjustable, heated front bucket seats with driver memory settings. High-tech features center around the modern MyFord Touch® infotainment interface powered by SYNC®, complete with dual 4.2-inch color displays in the instrument cluster and an 8-inch high-resolution center touchscreen. Ambient lighting, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a premium 12-speaker Sony® audio system with HD Radio™ elevate every drive to a first-class experience.

Bold Crossover Styling and Comprehensive Safety
Visually, the 2011 Edge Limited stands out with its sculpted profile, bold three-bar chrome grille, sleek rear spoiler, and striking 18-inch chrome-clad aluminum wheels. The 60/40 split-folding rear seat features EasyFold® remote seat release, expanding cargo capacity up to a generous 68.9 cubic feet. Built with safety top of mind, it comes equipped with AdvanceTrac® with Roll Stability Control™ (RSC®), a ParkSense® rear parking system, a backup camera, and an Safety Canopy® side-curtain airbag system. Offering bold styling, all-weather capability, and high-end luxury, the 2011 Ford Edge Limited AWD is a standout choice for discerning drivers.
